## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CME
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-11T04:50:13Z
## Message ID: 20240511-AL-009
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-11T01:36Z.

Estimated speed: ~1372 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 49 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 47/-1 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

NASA spacecraft near Earth and between Earth and Mars can be affected.  

The above parameters are preliminary, the CME is still being analyzed and updates will be provided when available. 

Activity ID: 2024-05-11T01:36:00-CME-001

## Notes: 

This CME event (2024-05-11T01:36:00-CME-001) is associated with X5.8 flare from Active Region 3664 (S17W47) with ID 2024-05-11T01:10:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-11T01:23Z (see notifications 20240511-AL-004, 20240511-AL-005) and SEP at GOES-P with ID 2024-05-11T02:10:00-SEP-001 (see notifications 20240511-AL-006, 20240511-AL-007).


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
